name: moto-travel-western-sichuan
description: Plan motorcycle roadbooks for Western Sichuan (Aba / Ganzi prefectures). Enforces real road geometry from Amap instead of straight lines, the Sichuan highway motorcycle ban, user-chosen holiday congestion avoidance, altitude acclimatization limits, historical snow risk per pass elevation, and fuel range planning. Exports Markdown, Excel, and an Amap JS HTML map.
